component-privacy-fingerprint-title: What this page can read about your browser
component-privacy-fingerprint-intro: Every website can read details like these without asking. Each one is common on its own. Together they are often rare enough to recognize your browser again, even without cookies.
component-privacy-fingerprint-button-sho: Show what this page can see
component-privacy-fingerprint-list-aria: Details this page read from your browser
component-privacy-fingerprint-tag-live-a: Read from your browser just now
component-privacy-fingerprint-device-cor: {count, plural, one {# CPU core} other {# CPU cores}}
component-privacy-fingerprint-gpu-hidden: Hidden by your browser, which is good for your privacy.
component-privacy-fingerprint-error: This browser didn't let the page read these details. That's good for your privacy, but it also means there's nothing to show.
component-privacy-fingerprint-wallets-co: {count, plural, one {# wallet} other {# wallets}} answered
component-privacy-fingerprint-wallets-ex: Browser wallets announce themselves to any page that asks, before you click Connect. This page only counts the answers. It doesn't connect to any wallet or read your accounts.
component-privacy-fingerprint-explainer: The fingerprint is a short code made from the details above, plus a small drawing your browser made in the background. Differences in hardware, drivers and fonts make that drawing come out slightly differently on different devices. The same browser usually produces the same code tomorrow, even in a private window or behind a VPN.
component-privacy-fingerprint-how: How it's made: the page combines your time zone, languages, device details, graphics chip, browser version and the hidden drawing, then turns them into a short code with a hash function.
component-privacy-fingerprint-trackers: Many websites run third-party scripts that collect details like these and send them to advertising and tracking services, which can use them to follow you from site to site.
component-privacy-fingerprint-caption: These values were read from your browser just now and are shown only to you.
component-privacy-fingerprint-privacy-no: Everything here is read and shown in your browser. This widget doesn't send any of it anywhere.
component-privacy-fingerprint-learn-more: To reduce what websites can read about you, see <link>how to protect your privacy online</link>.
